comment: Reviewed npm advisories that do not reach the shipped app. Each entry: the advisory, the package, where it is used, and why the app is not affected. scripts/check-audit.js fails on any advisory not listed here. Remove an entry as soon as a fixed version can be installed.

advisories.reason: ReDoS on crafted extglob patterns. Used only by build and test tooling (Metro, Jest, Expo CLI, typescript-eslint file matching) with glob patterns from this project's own configuration, never from user input, and not in the app bundle. No fixed release exists (4.0.7 is the latest).

Denial of service via globparts amplification. Build and test tooling only (Jest coverage, Expo fingerprinting, glob) with project-controlled patterns; not in the app bundle. The fixed major (11) is not accepted by the dependent tools' ranges.

AbortSignal cancellation bypass. Build and test tooling only (Jest, babel-plugin-istanbul) walking this project's own folders; the app never passes an AbortSignal to glob and glob is not in the app bundle.
